text.text: The Plated Boots protect the feet and enable mobility modifiers like Feather Falling and Double Jump.
Requires 4 plating units, crafted in the Tool Station.

properties: Feather Falling reduces fall damage 12% per level
Double Jump (slime) gives a mid-air jump
Ricochet gives a chance to bounce arrows back
Material determines durability, defense, toughness and knockback resistance
